market_summary: Nifty fell 0.63% to 25,228 and Sensex 0.61% to 82,032 on Wed 18 Nov as traders booked profits after a 12-session rally; metals fell about 2.5%, consumer durables 3% (jewellers hit by gold at a 14-month low) and IT 1.2%, while SBI, Cipla and PSU banks rose. Breadth was weak (1,448 up, 2,800 down on BSE) and midcaps fell 1.2%. Foreign investors bought ₹5,867 cr while domestic funds sold ₹3,160 cr, and India VIX closed at 15.56 (+0.26%); results season is almost over, so moves now come from broker notes.

buy_ideas.name: Laurus Labs
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue rose about 33% to ₹2,206 cr, led by CDMO up about 86% to ₹875 cr. EBITDA was ₹750 cr with a 34% margin, up 962 bps, and profit was ₹437 cr. The strongest earnings quality on today's list.
buy_ideas.risks: Target is only about 9% above the price, so the upside is modest after a big run. CDMO orders are lumpy, and the Laurus Bio unit fell about 38%. Price is the broker's reference price; check the live quote.

buy_ideas.name: ABB India
buy_ideas.thesis: September-quarter revenue up 12% and profit up 8%, with a record order book up 36% to about ₹12,900 cr. Two brokers now say Buy, with targets about 18-20% above the price.
buy_ideas.risks: Margin fell 70 bps and profit growth was modest. Valued at about 60 times 2028 earnings. Capital-goods stocks fell with the market on 18 Nov.

buy_ideas.name: Hitachi Energy India
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 64% and profit up 21%; new orders up 86%, taking the order book to ₹33,300 cr. IDBI Capital's target is about 25% above the price.
buy_ideas.risks: No fresh news today; the price is implied from the 17 Nov note, so check the live quote. Very expensive stock, and profit grew much slower than revenue.
